name: Chair Squat
instructions: Stand in front of a sturdy chair with feet hip-width apart.
Lower your hips back and down slowly as if sitting in the chair.
Lightly touch the seat with your glutes without collapsing.
Press through your heels to stand back up straight.
mistakes: Plop down heavily onto the chair
breathing: Inhale as you sit down; exhale as you push up to standing.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold a light dumbbell or water bottle close to your chest with both hands.
Stand with feet slightly wider than hip-width, toes pointing slightly out.
Bend knees and sit back, keeping chest tall and upper body upright.
Lower until thighs are parallel to ground or as far as comfortable.
Drive through heels to stand upright.
mistakes: Holding the weight far away from chest
breathing: Inhale on the way down; exhale forcefully as you drive up.

name: Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit tall in a chair with feet flat on the floor and core engaged.
Hold weights at shoulder height with elbows bent and palms facing forward.
Press the weights smoothly overhead until arms are nearly straight.
Pause briefly at top, then lower under control back to shoulders.
breathing: Exhale as you press upward; inhale as you lower the weights.

name: Bent-over Row
instructions: Stand with knees slightly bent and hinge at hips with back flat.
Let weights hang down toward floor with palms facing each other.
Pull elbows straight back toward hips, squeezing shoulder blades.
Lower weights back down under control without rounding back.
mistakes: Rounding the spine into a curve
Looking straight up and straining neck
breathing: Exhale as you pull weights toward hips; inhale as you lower.

name: Biceps Curl
instructions: Stand tall or sit in a chair with arms at your sides holding weights.
Keep elbows tucked close to your torso.
Bend elbows and curl weights up toward shoulders.
Squeeze biceps at the top, then slowly lower back down.
breathing: Exhale while curling up; inhale while lowering down.
svgIllustration: <svg viewBox='0 0 200 200' class='svg-illustration'><rect width='200' height='200' rx='16' fill='#E8F5E9'/><circle cx='100' cy='45' r='14' fill='#333333'/><path d='M100 59 L100 115 L90 165 L110 165' stroke='#333333' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round' fill='none'/><path d='M100 70 L98 95 L115 80' stroke='#4CAF50' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round' fill='none'/><circle cx='118' cy='78' r='6' fill='#FFB74D'/><line x1='30' y1='165' x2='170' y2='165' stroke='#A5D6A7' stroke-width='4'/></svg>

name: Triceps Extension
equipment: Chair & 1 Light Dumbbell or Water Bottle
instructions: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat.
Hold one weight overhead with both hands, elbows pointing forward.
Slowly bend elbows to lower weight behind your head.
Extend arms back up overhead, squeezing back of arms.
mistakes: Moving upper arms back and forth
breathing: Inhale as you lower behind head; exhale as you extend overhead.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on back with knees bent and feet flat on floor, hip-width apart.
Rest arms flat by your sides with palms down.
Press heels into floor and squeeze glutes to lift hips toward ceiling.
Form a straight line from knees to shoulders, hold 1-2 sec, then lower.
mistakes: Pushing off toes instead of heels
breathing: Exhale as you lift hips; inhale as you slowly lower down.
svgIllustration: <svg viewBox='0 0 200 200' class='svg-illustration'><rect width='200' height='200' rx='16' fill='#E8F5E9'/><line x1='20' y1='155' x2='180' y2='155' stroke='#A5D6A7' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/><circle cx='45' cy='140' r='12' fill='#333333'/><path d='M57 142 L95 120 L135 125 L155 155' stroke='#4CAF50' stroke-width='9' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round' fill='none'/><path d='M57 148 L110 148' stroke='#333333' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/></svg>

name: Standing Calf Raise
equipment: Wall or Chair Back for Support
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, holding a wall or chair back for balance.
Press down through balls of feet and raise heels high off floor.
Pause briefly at top feeling calves contract.
Lower heels back to floor slowly under control.
mistakes: Leaning heavily on chair for support
breathing: Exhale as you rise up onto toes; inhale as you lower heels.

name: Farmer Carry
instructions: Hold a light weight or filled water bottle/bag in each hand at sides.
Stand tall, pull shoulders down and back, engage core.
Walk forward with slow, controlled, even steps.
Maintain upright posture without tilting or leaning.
mistakes: Walking too fast or taking uneven strides
breathing: Breathe steadily and deeply through nose throughout walk.

name: Wall Push-up
instructions: Stand facing a wall about arm's length away with feet shoulder-width apart.
Place palms flat on wall at shoulder height and shoulder-width apart.
Bend elbows slowly and lower chest toward wall, keeping body straight.
Push firmly against wall to return to starting position.
mistakes: Bending only at neck instead of elbows
breathing: Inhale as you lower toward wall; exhale as you push away.
svgIllustration: <svg viewBox='0 0 200 200' class='svg-illustration'><rect width='200' height='200' rx='16' fill='#E8F5E9'/><line x1='160' y1='20' x2='160' y2='180' stroke='#8D6E63' stroke-width='8'/><circle cx='80' cy='55' r='14' fill='#333333'/><path d='M80 69 L100 115 L120 165' stroke='#333333' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/><path d='M90 80 L158 85' stroke='#4CAF50' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/><line x1='30' y1='165' x2='170' y2='165' stroke='#A5D6A7' stroke-width='4'/></svg>

name: Gentle Whole Body Stretch
instructions: Reach both arms gently overhead toward ceiling, stretching spine.
Lower arms and reach across chest for shoulder stretch.
Gently tilt head side to side to relax neck tension.
Finish with gentle side bends left and right.
mistakes: Stretching to point of pain instead of mild tension
breathing: Take deep, calm breaths in through nose and slow out through mouth.

name: Brisk Mindful Walk
instructions: Wear supportive shoes and stand tall with shoulders relaxed.
Walk at a comfortable, brisk pace where you can still talk easily.
Swing arms gently at sides to match your stride.
Cool down last 2 minutes with slow easy pace.
mistakes: Looking down at feet instead of ahead
breathing: Breathe naturally in rhythm with your footsteps.
